title: Kokoro / OpenAI-compatible (speech)
description: A text-to-speech model on any server that speaks OpenAI's speech API (Kokoro-FastAPI, openedai-speech, Speaches), on this machine or your network, as gohort's voice, with the server's voice list for the Voice field: the request and the reply are data you can test and fix from Admin > Connectors.
setup_notes: Start the server (Kokoro-FastAPI: docker run -p 8880:8880 ghcr.io/remsky/kokoro-fastapi-cpu). The connector takes no key. Choose it under Capabilities > Speech (TTS) and give the server's address and the model there; Test there speaks a short sentence, and its voices are offered to choose from. A server with no voice list (/audio/voices) fails that part of the Test: remove the speech.voices entry from its spec, and type the voice. A server that takes a key: declare a secret setting sent as bearer in its spec's config, name it in auth in place of none, and give the key under the choice.

questions.name: name
questions.label: Connector name
questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; the speech settings list it by this name.

config.name: base_url
config.label: Server address
config.help: The address its /audio/speech is under, usually ending in /v1: http://localhost:8880/v1 for Kokoro-FastAPI.

config.name: model
config.label: Model
config.help: The model the server speaks with: Kokoro-FastAPI takes kokoro.

config.name: voice
config.label: Default voice
config.help: Used when the speech settings name none: Kokoro's af_heart, say. The speech settings' Voice overrides it.
